headline_marked: [[US, Saudi forces strike Iran-backed militants]] in Iraq after drone attacks, warn of further response
headline: US, Saudi forces strike Iran-backed militants in Iraq after drone attacks, warn of further response
summary: US and Saudi warplanes carried out joint strikes against Iran-backed groups in Iraq, following over two dozen drone attacks targeting US forces and Saudi energy infrastructure.
details: US and Saudi warplanes conducted strikes on Tuesday against Iran-backed militants in Iraq. This action came after these groups launched more than two dozen drone attacks in recent days.

US Central Command (CENTCOM) stated the strikes targeted "Iran-aligned terrorists that the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) directed to attack US forces and Saudi energy infrastructure." CENTCOM also warned that the IRGC and its proxies must cease these attacks to avoid further US military response.

Saudi Arabia confirmed its involvement, with its defense ministry stating it hit "targets belonging to those militias present on Iraqi territory that are linked to attacks on the kingdom's oil facilities."

The strikes followed the Saudi ministry's interception of drones targeting oil facilities in the east, which they blamed on Iran-backed groups in Iraq. Riyadh had previously urged the Iraqi government to prevent attacks from its territory, prompting Baghdad to order an investigation.

Earlier on Tuesday, CENTCOM reported that Iran launched multiple ballistic missiles in an "attempted surprise attack on US forces based in the Middle East," all of which were intercepted. Both sides had observed a ceasefire over the weekend, after nearly two weeks of US strikes on Iran and repeated missile and drone salvos by Tehran targeting Washington's allies.

headline_marked: [[US forces thwarted Iran's missile attack]] in Middle East, CENTCOM claims
headline: US forces thwarted Iran's missile attack in Middle East, CENTCOM claims
summary: US Central Command (CENTCOM) stated that multiple ballistic missiles launched from Iran targeting US forces in the Middle East were successfully intercepted. American forces are maintaining maximum readiness.
details: The US military announced that an unexpected attack launched by Iran targeting US forces stationed in the Middle East was successfully thwarted. This information was reported by CNN, citing a post from US Central Command (CENTCOM) on social media.

CENTCOM stated that Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) launched multiple ballistic missiles from Iran, aiming for US forces in the Middle East. All missiles fired by Iran were successfully intercepted, preventing any impact.
US forces are currently on high alert and maintaining maximum readiness following the incident. CENTCOM also confirmed that no more than four ballistic missiles were launched during the attack.
This incident follows earlier remarks by former US President Donald Trump, who had stated that the United States had ceased attacks on Iran and that Iran had expressed interest in negotiations.
However, Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson Ismail Baghei presented a different stance, asserting that there are currently no discussions ongoing with the United States.
caption:
Iran launched multiple ballistic missiles targeting US forces in the Middle East. All were successfully intercepted by US military.

The US military announced that an unexpected attack launched by Iran targeting US forces stationed in the Middle East was successfully thwarted. This information was reported by CNN, citing a post from US Central Command (CENTCOM) on social media.

CENTCOM stated that Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) launched multiple ballistic missiles from Iran, aiming for US forces in the Middle East. All missiles fired by Iran were successfully intercepted, preventing any impact.

US forces are currently on high alert and maintaining maximum readiness following the incident. CENTCOM also confirmed that no more than four ballistic missiles were launched during the attack.

This incident follows earlier remarks by former US President Donald Trump, who had stated that the United States had ceased attacks on Iran and that Iran had expressed interest in negotiations.

However, Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesperson Ismail Baghei presented a different stance, asserting that there are currently no discussions ongoing with the United States.
